## Key Decisions
- Text-based contradiction detection REMOVED entirely from fallback path — only structured validation is a valid contradiction now
- Read-only inspection prompts route through the SAME persistent worker queue as developer_executor, but with `executionMode: 'read_only'` — never through narrative fallback model
- Read-only worker policy: PERMITTED = inspect files, search code, inspect logs, run safe read-only commands, run tests (no source mutation), identify root cause; BLOCKED = editing files, committing, pushing, deploying, applying migrations, changing production data
- Read-only answer format is strict 10-section (TASK ID / STATUS / MODE: READ_ONLY / FILES INSPECTED / COMMANDS RUN / FINDINGS / ROOT CAUSE / FILES CHANGED: NONE / COMMIT: NOT REQUESTED / DEPLOYMENT: NOT REQUESTED / NEXT ACTION)
- Vendor-independence: removed all code-level Rork dependencies removable from sandbox; 10 owner-action-only dependencies honestly documented
- Backend `rork-direct.workers.dev` references are BLOCKLIST detection only (rejecting Rork URLs) — NOT runtime dependencies
- Cannot self-remove the Rork sandbox itself or revoke owner-controlled external account access
